subject: Reserved capacity SLAs & burst credits — pipeline triage
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-09-12T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Reserved capacity SLAs & burst credits — pipeline triage

Folks,

Looping you in on NorthStar (DEAL-7682) — they want a committed dedicated deployment to support a customer POC that will likely convert to a full reserved contract. Quick summary: 

- Ask: 8 reserved GPUs (p4d-equivalent pool) + 2 burst slots for traffic spikes.
- Start target: 2028-10-03 (POC starts Oct 3, production TBD).
- Traffic profile (high level): 500k inference requests/day, avg seq len 256, peak concurrency ~220 requests/sec.
- Expected ARR on reserved commit: ~$720k/yr for 12 months (chargeback model).

Attachments: northstar_forecast_q3_v2.xlsx (pipeline + traffic profile). Please confirm infra feasibility and finance consumables/discount guidance.

Key asks: 
1) Infra: can we provision 8 reserved GPUs by Oct 1 and keep 2 burst slots? Any constraints or alternative suggestions (e.g., 6 reserved + 2 burst)?
2) Finance: what approvals/discounts do we need to offer for a $700k+ commit and which billing cadence options are preferred?
3) Ops: what runbook/provisioning lead time do you need if we greenlight?

Thanks — Ben

--
Ben Carter
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-09-12T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Reserved capacity SLAs & burst credits — pipeline triage

On Tue, Sep 12, 2028 at 09:15 AM Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Folks,
> 
> Looping you in on NorthStar (DEAL-7682) — they want a committed dedicated deployment to support a customer POC that will likely convert to a full reserved contract.

Thanks for the summary, Ben. A few infra notes and requests from my side: 

- Short answer: provisioning 8 reserved GPUs is feasible but tight for an Oct 1 start depending on current pool utilization and region. We can do 6 reserved + 2 burst as an explicit plan B that still meets SLAs for the POC.
- Need the following from the customer ASAP: typical sequence length distribution (not just avg), per-request token budget for both prompt + generation, and expected steady-state qps vs peak qps over 5–10 minute windows. These drive memory/KV cache and batching config.
- Concurrency model: if they plan many simultaneous short requests we should provision more concurrency (more smaller instances) vs fewer large ones.
- Runbook: provisioning timeline is ~7–10 business days once we lock the SKU and region. If they need Oct 3 hard start, we should lock by Sep 20.

Action: Ben/Olga, can you confirm region (us-west1 preferred) and ask NorthStar for sequence distribution CSV attached to the forecast? If they can't provide, we'll size conservatively and recommend 6 reserved + 2 burst to avoid overcommitting.

-Karthik

--
Karthik Iyer
Head of Fleet Infrastructure, Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-09-13T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Reserved capacity SLAs & burst credits — pipeline triage

Thanks for the heads-up. A few finance items: 

- Pricing/discounts: For a committed ARR in the ~$700k range we can approve up to a 10% contract discount under standard terms. Anything beyond that needs VP approval.
- Billing cadence: we prefer quarterly advance billing for Dedicated to match reserved capacity costs, but monthly upfront is tolerable for strategic POCs (must be explicit in SOW).
- SLA credits: adding burst credits changes the economics; please confirm expected burst hours per month so we can model consumption and rebate exposure.
- Commercial documents: I need the final deal sheet + margin model by Sep 18 to route approvals and determine if we can include a one-time onboarding credit.

If the team lands on 6 reserved + 2 burst instead of 8 reserved, update projected ARR and I will re-run numbers.

-Laura

--
Laura Bennett
Director, Finance (Commercial) — Redwood Inference
From: Jason Dunn <jdunn@northstar.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: sara.procurement@acme.com
Date: 2028-09-13T12:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Reserved capacity SLAs & burst credits — pipeline triage

Hi all,

Thanks for the quick turn. A few clarifications from NorthStar: 

- We can provide the sequence distribution CSV by end of day Sep 14. Expect a long tail: 70% requests < 128 tokens, 20% between 128-512, 10% >512.
- Peak concurrency expectation for POC: ~200–250 concurrent in a 10-minute window.
- Burst hours: estimate ~50 GPU-hours/month during POC month (spiky evaluation runs).
- Region: us-west1 is preferred.
- Start date: Oct 3 for the POC test runners (we can be flexible by a day or two but prefer that week).

Ben — we confirm we're aligned on the ARR and will sign a 12-month reserved SOW if POC metrics meet the bar. I'll upload the CSV and a short technical profile to the shared Drive link.

Regards,
Jason

--
Jason Dunn
Head of ML Infrastructure, NorthStar AI
jdunn@northstar.ai
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>

Cc: jdunn@northstar.ai
Date: 2028-09-14T09:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Reserved capacity SLAs & burst credits — pipeline triage

Thanks everyone — quick triage and plan based on the inputs: 

Decision: provision 6 reserved GPUs in us-west1 + enable 2 burst slots for the POC. We'll treat this as Remedy Plan B to avoid over-allocating capacity. If NorthStar's sequence distribution (CSV) confirms heavier tail than stated, we will escalate to 8 reserved.

Timeline & owners: 
- Provisioning ticket (infra): Karthik to open by Sep 15 — ETA provisioning complete Sep 28–30.
- Commercial sheet (finance): Ben to submit updated ARR/margin model reflecting 6+2 by Sep 17. Laura to sign off on discount by Sep 20.
- Customer deliverables: Jason/NorthStar to upload sequence CSV and test job schedule by Sep 14 (Jason confirmed).
- Runbook & SLA: Marcus to finalize capacity_runbook_v1.md and SLA handoff notes by Sep 21.

Attachments pushed: reserved_sla_matrix.pdf (draft), capacity_runbook_v1.md, northstar_forecast_q3_v2.xlsx.

If we see the POC metrics exceed expectations mid-month, infra will activate an emergency scale (burst credits) and finance will track consumption for reconciliation.

Next steps: Ben to confirm HubSpot deal record has start date and the updated commercial terms; Karthik to create the infra ticket with exact SKU/region. We'll re-open this thread for the provisioning close-out.

Thanks — Olga

--

Manager, Sales Operations — Redwood Inference
